head-description: Bludit is free and open-source! If you love it and want to help us grow, please consider supporting its development on Patreon. As a big thank you, you'll get access to Bludit PRO.
description-paragraph1: Bludit is free and open-source! If you love it and want to help us grow, please consider supporting its development on Patreon. As a big thank you, you'll get access to Bludit PRO.
white-labeling-description: Easily swap Bludit branding for your own on themes and the login page—perfect for agencies or Freelancers working on client projects.
time-machine-description: Oops, made a mistake? No worries! Time Machine lets you roll back any content to a previous version. It's the ultimate safety net for editors.
backup-manager-description: Back up your entire site with just one click. We'll handle your content, uploads, settings, and databases. Download and restore whenever you need peace of mind.
gallery-description: Manage image galleries directly from the admin panel. Thumbnails are generated automatically, and you can embed galleries anywhere with a simple Shortcode.
agencies-description: Need White Labeling for client work? Swap out Bludit branding on themes and the login page so every client touchpoint reflects your brand.
freelancers-description: Want professional tools without the overhead? PRO gives you everything you need to deliver client projects with confidence.
developers-description: Love simplicity but need production-ready features? PRO extends Bludit without adding complexity to your Stack.
self-hosters-description: Want peace of mind with backups and version control? Backup Manager and Time Machine have you covered.
how-to-get-it-description: Bludit PRO is available from the $2 tier and above on Patreon. There's no separate purchase—just pick any qualifying tier and get instant access to every PRO plugin.
are-you-happy-with-bludit: Loving Bludit? If you want to say thanks, you can buy me a coffee or a beer via PayPal or BTC. Cheers!
